headline: BNP authorizes Tarique Rahman to finalize presidential candidate
summary: The party's Standing Committee has entrusted the BNP Chairperson with the responsibility of nominating the candidate for the presidency.
details: The Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP) has authorized its Chairperson, Tarique Rahman, to finalize the selection of the party's candidate for the presidency.
caption:
Who will be the BNP's presidential candidate? The decision now rests with Tarique Rahman.

headline_marked: Police HQ issues [[highest alert nationwide]] over vehicle attack threats
headline: Police HQ issues highest alert nationwide over vehicle attack threats
summary: Authorities have ordered increased security for all government vehicles, including those in parking lots, following reports of potential targets.
details: Police Headquarters has issued a nationwide highest alert after receiving information that police vehicles could be the target of attacks.
In an emergency message sent on Saturday, all field-level units were instructed to strengthen security measures across the country.
The directive specifically orders increased protection for all government vehicles, whether they are on duty or parked in designated areas.
Police personnel have been told to increase patrols, surveillance, and to remain vigilant in identifying any suspicious objects near vehicles.
This high-alert status comes in the wake of recent panic and security concerns surrounding Metro Rail stations.
All units are now on high alert to prevent any potential sabotage or attacks on police transport and infrastructure.
caption:
